# Editmamei

> Editmamei is a local MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets an AI assistant drive Adobe Photoshop on your own computer using natural language. It is not a web app, not a cloud image editor, and does not upload your files anywhere.

Editmamei installs as an npm package and runs locally on macOS or Windows alongside your existing copy of Adobe Photoshop. An AI client (such as Claude Desktop or any MCP-compatible client) sends instructions to Editmamei, which translates them into native Photoshop operations via ExtendScript. Your PSD files stay on your machine. No pixels leave your computer unless your AI client itself sends them (e.g. for a preview).

## What Editmamei is

- A local MCP server that bridges AI assistants and Adobe Photoshop
- Non-destructive AI photo editing for Photoshop: color grading, retouching, layer management, masking, adjustments, filters, and more
- A Photoshop assistant: connect Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or Cursor and edit by conversation
- Photoshop automation without scripting: repeatable Pro templates reapply a saved look photo by photo
- Compatible with any MCP-capable AI client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)
- Local-first: your photo files and documents stay on your computer; Editmamei itself uploads no image content
- Reports anonymous, content-free usage data (opt-out); never your images, documents, or file paths
- Requires an existing Adobe Photoshop license (it drives your copy, it is not a replacement)

## What Editmamei is not

- Not a web app or browser-based editor
- Not a cloud image editor (no uploads, no cloud processing of your images)
- Not a generative AI model or image generator
- Not a Photoshop plugin or extension
- Not a replacement for Photoshop — it orchestrates Photoshop, it does not replace it
- Not affiliated with Adobe

## Editions

- **Community Edition (CE)**: Free and source-available under the Functional Source License (FSL-1.1-MIT), available via npm as `editmamei`. Source: https://github.com/editmamei/editmamei. Covers the everyday editing surface: documents, layers, non-destructive adjustments, filters, masks, selections (including Photoshop's AI Select Subject and Select Sky), shape layers and pen paths, channel compositing, content-aware retouch, on-device scene awareness (object/face detection, selecting things by name), history, and visual verification.
- **Pro Edition**: Paid license, activated over the same package. Adds the develop-grade and precision toolkit: Camera Raw develop as a re-editable Smart Filter, precision placement (name a location, get verified geometry), named-object masks, a 468-point face mesh with feature selections, subject-instance targeting, warp, the reproducible-template system, and Photoshop Actions plus ExtendScript scripting.
